q1_issues.issue: (Possession sk_family_1 sk_victims_1) asserts a possessor the text never states — "pending family notification" contains no possessive, so no words put this atom there.
"notification" is rendered as the verb lemma notify, which is derivation rather than inflection; an event-denoting noun keeps its own noun form.
(Recipient sk_notify_1 sk_family_1) reads a thematic role off the noun-noun compound "family notification"; the compound-kind route yields a genus, and a noun modifier is never exposed as a role.
(Manner sk_release_1 immediately) slots a promptness/temporal adverb into Manner, which answers how the action was performed.

q2_gaps: promptness / temporal adverbs ("immediately") have no licensed slot — Manner is for manner and the Time role takes calendar, deictic or day-part terms

a deverbal event-noun compound inside an adjunct ("pending family notification") — no rule says whether to keep the noun as the witness's class, fuse family_notification with its genus, or reify it as an event with roles

an episodic bare-plural subject ("Authorities did not ... release") — a bare plural is the generic signal, yet the clause is a specific past episode; the group-witness reading used here is not covered by any rule
notes: The negation shape is right — one strength-0 (And ...) holding the event class, roles, adverb, tense and the pending oblique, with the definite identities and victims typings projected outside it. Pending is licensed as one of the genuine -ing prepositions, and scoping "immediately" inside the denial gives the correct not-immediately reading.
